* Accept-Encoding SIP (HTTP) Header. * * @author M. Ranganathan * @author Olivier Deruelle
* @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.7 $ $Date: 2009/07/17 18:57:24 $ * @since 1.1 * * 
 *  From HTTP RFC 2616
 *
 *
 *    The Accept-Encoding request-header field is similar to Accept, but
 *    restricts the content-codings (section 3.5) that are acceptable in
 *    the response.
 *
 *
 *        Accept-Encoding  = "Accept-Encoding" ":"
 *
 *
 *                           1#( codings [ ";" "q" "=" qvalue ] )
 *        codings          = ( content-coding | "*" )
 *
 *    Examples of its use are:
 *
 *        Accept-Encoding: compress, gzip
 *        Accept-Encoding:
 *        Accept-Encoding: *
 *        Accept-Encoding: compress;q=0.5, gzip;q=1.0
 *        Accept-Encoding: gzip;q=1.0, identity; q=0.5, *;q=0
 *
*

methods.name: protected String encodeBody()

* Encode the value of this header.
